text: Text sizes are now Biggest, Medium and Small.
Water sits on the left, with Headache, Day and Blood glucose on the right. Weight and Medicines run underneath.
A Most used row of five foods sits above the meal choices.
Nutrition can be entered per serving or per 100 g. Per 100 g asks for the grams in one serving.
Scan a barcode fills in the food name and nutrition from the pack. Only the number is looked up.
Admin now has side tabs: Diary screens, Doctor accounts, Admin PIN and Reset data.
Water, meals, headaches, saved foods, readings and other data can now be reset one kind at a time. Each asks for DELETE.
Doctors now has side tabs for people, targets, medicines, relief, clinical notes and the change log.
Tester notes has a checklist with barcode items, a comment box, and Share or Save as file.
New: this What's new card. It appears only on screens that changed. Got it hides it, and Tester notes keeps a Past updates list.
